name: lumiverse-auto-retry
description: Automatically re-fires failed, stalled, empty, or cut-off generations, with optional accidental-refusal retry and an optional find-and-replace on replies. Event-driven port of the SillyTavern fetch-retry idea, with an in-app settings modal.
author: starlitcode

scripts.build:frontend: bun build src/frontend.ts --outfile dist/frontend.js --format esm --target browser
scripts.build:backend: bun build src/backend.ts --outfile dist/backend.js --format esm --target bun
scripts.build: bun run build:frontend && bun run build:backend
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:frontend && bun run typecheck:backend
